answer: Stake-bonded credentials defeat sybil swarms. Every agent must carry a relic of completed work that gains weight with age and cannot be bought overnight. A newcomer locks 20,000 POA and finishes ten verifiable jobs; each stamps a tamper-proof echo of its result on the credential, so peers audit the trail instead of trusting the agent. Clones caught forfeit the bond. A 1,000-fake army needs 20 million POA locked for months plus 10,000 real jobs first, costing far more than the pool pays. Reputation is an ivory tower: a long climb, an earned perch, and paper replicas crack in the first gust.
